//: Typecheck config for the icme tree (ags-apps/icme) — the icon colour
WHY THIS GATE EXISTS: `ags bundle` TRANSPILES WITHOUT TYPE CHECKING, so a
type error is an app that builds and fails at runtime. Same posture as the
bar's tsconfig.bar.json and the other migrated apps' configs.
`ags types -u` writes its OWN `tsconfig.json` into whichever directory it
runs against and OVERWRITES it on every run, so this file deliberately
uses a non-colliding name. Do not rename it to tsconfig.json.
`make icme-types` runs `ags types -d icme -u`, generating this tree's OWN
@girs/ + env.d.ts: the GIR modules describe THIS machine, not the
consuming tree. The Makefile gate declares that dependency explicitly.
The `ags`/`ags/*` paths map (identical to tsconfig.bar.json) makes `ags`
resolve for EVERY file in the program, including the external platform's
adapters (which import `ags/gtk4/app`), instead of depending on where a
per-directory symlink happens to sit. `resolveJsonModule` is required
because the platform's adapters/icon-registry.ts imports its own icons.json.
`skipLibCheck` skips the generated @girs/ identifier clashes. `lib` needs
ES2022+DOM for the gnim JSX runtime.
